direction: Warm editorial photography of achievable Bengali and Indian home cooking, not restaurant plating.
composition: Show the entire three-dish meal together in one coherent frame. Every named dish must be clearly visible in its own simple cream ceramic bowl or plate, arranged naturally on a worn wooden dining table.
lighting: Soft natural window light, gentle shadows, realistic food texture, inviting evening-at-home atmosphere.
palette: Warm cream, mustard yellow, chilli red and dark green accents with restrained Bengali textile details.
avoid: text, lettering, labels, logos or watermarks
invented dishes or ingredients not named in the meal
